title.en: Design and implement a data model

takeaways.en: A star schema puts fact tables in the centre and dimension tables around them, each related one-to-many.
takeaways.zh: 星型架构把事实表放在中心，维度表围绕四周，彼此以一对多关系连接。

takeaways.en: Filters flow from the "one" side (dimension) to the "many" side (fact).
takeaways.zh: 筛选从「一」端（维度表）流向「多」端（事实表）。

takeaways.en: Avoid one big flat table and avoid snowflakes of chained dimensions: the star is simpler and faster.
takeaways.zh: 避免一张大扁平表，也避免多层串接的雪花型维度：星型更简单、更快。

alt.en: Star schema: Sales in the centre related to Date, Product, Customer and Store
alt.zh: 星型架构：Sales 在中心，关联 Date、Product、Customer 和 Store

caption.en: A star schema. Each dimension (1) filters the fact table (*).
caption.zh: 星型架构。每张维度表（1）筛选事实表（*）。

html.en: Power BI's engine and DAX are designed around the star schema. Slicers and axes come from the dimension tables; the numbers you add up live in the fact table. One relationship per dimension, each one-to-many with a single cross-filter direction from dimension to fact.
html.zh: Power BI 的引擎和 DAX 都是围绕星型架构设计的。切片器和轴来自维度表；要汇总的数字放在事实表中。每张维度表一个关系，都是一对多，筛选方向为从维度表到事实表的单向。

rows.zh: 所有内容放在一张扁平表

rows.en: Repeats descriptive text on every row (big model), hard to add a second fact table, awkward time intelligence
rows.zh: 每一行都重复描述文字（模型大），难以加入第二张事实表，时间智能也难做

rows.en: Longer filter paths, more tables to understand; flatten the chain into one Product dimension in Power Query
rows.zh: 筛选路径更长、要理解的表更多；应在 Power Query 中把这串表展平成一个 Product 维度表

rows.en: Small, fast, easy to read; the recommended design

html.en: Two fact tables (for example Sales and Budget) can share the same dimensions. These conformed dimensions let one slicer filter both facts at once.
html.zh: 两张事实表（例如 Sales 和 Budget）可以共用相同的维度表。这种一致性维度表让一个切片器同时筛选两张事实表。

q.en: Product, Subcategory and Category are three related tables. What does Microsoft guidance recommend for a Power BI model?
q.zh: Product、Subcategory 和 Category 是三张相互关联的表。对 Power BI 模型，Microsoft 指南建议怎么做？

html.en: Merge them into the Sales fact table
html.zh: 把它们合并进 Sales 事实表

why.en: That repeats text on every sales row.
why.zh: 这会在每一行销售记录中重复文字。

html.en: Relate each one to Sales directly
html.zh: 让每一张都直接关联 Sales

html.en: Keep the snowflake as it is

why.en: It works, but adds filter hops and complexity.
why.zh: 可以运作，但会增加筛选跳转和复杂度。

html.en: Merge them into one Product dimension (denormalise)
html.zh: 把它们合并成一个 Product 维度表（反规范化）

why.en: Right: a star with one Product table is simpler and faster.
why.zh: 对：只有一张 Product 表的星型更简单、更快。

heading.zh: 关系：基数与交叉筛选方向

takeaways.en: Cardinality can be one-to-many, many-to-one, one-to-one or many-to-many; one-to-many is the normal case.
takeaways.zh: 基数可以是一对多、多对一、一对一或多对多；一对多是最常见的情况。

takeaways.en: Cross-filter direction Single filters from the one side to the many side; Both also filters back — use it sparingly.
takeaways.zh: 交叉筛选方向「单向」从「一」端筛选到「多」端；「双向」也会反向筛选——要谨慎使用。

takeaways.en: Only one active relationship can exist between two tables; others are inactive (dashed) and used with USERELATIONSHIP.
takeaways.zh: 两张表之间只能有一个活动关系；其他关系为非活动（虚线），需用 USERELATIONSHIP 启用。

rows.en: Each key appears once on one side, many times on the other
rows.zh: 键在一端只出现一次，在另一端出现多次

rows.en: Unique on both sides; often means the tables should be merged
rows.zh: 两端都唯一；通常表示两张表应该合并

rows.en: Neither side unique; use carefully, totals may surprise
rows.zh: 两端都不唯一；要小心使用，合计可能出乎意料

rows.en: Sales (by month) ↔ Budget (by month and category)

html.en: Cross-filter direction

alt.en: Single direction: Product filters Sales. Both: Sales also filters Product.
alt.zh: 单向：Product 筛选 Sales。双向：Sales 也筛选 Product。

caption.en: Single (top) is the default for one-to-many. Both (bottom) lets the fact table filter the dimension too.
caption.zh: 单向（上）是一对多的默认值。双向（下）让事实表也能筛选维度表。

items.en: Single: the dimension filters the fact. A slicer on Product[Colour] filters Sales.
items.zh: 单向：维度表筛选事实表。Product[Colour] 切片器会筛选 Sales。

items.en: Both: the fact also filters the dimension, e.g. a Customer slicer that shows only customers who bought the selected product. It can create ambiguous paths and slows queries.
items.zh: 双向：事实表也会筛选维度表，例如 Customer 切片器只显示购买了所选产品的客户。它可能造成路径不明确，并拖慢查询。

items.en: Prefer a measure-based fix for one visual: CALCULATE([Sales], CROSSFILTER(Sales[CustomerID], Customer[CustomerID], BOTH)), or filter a slicer with a measure ("show items where [Sales] is not blank").
items.zh: 如果只是一个视觉对象需要，优先用度量值解决：CALCULATE([Sales], CROSSFILTER(Sales[CustomerID], Customer[CustomerID], BOTH))，或用度量值筛选切片器（「只显示 [Sales] 不为空的项目」）。

html.en: Active and inactive relationships

Between two tables only one relationship can be active (solid line). A second one, for example Sales[ShipDate] → Date[Date] next to the active Sales[OrderDate] → Date[Date], is inactive (dashed line). Turn it on inside one measure with USERELATIONSHIP:
html.zh: 两张表之间只能有一个活动关系（实线）。第二个关系，例如在活动的 Sales[OrderDate] → Date[Date] 之外再加 Sales[ShipDate] → Date[Date]，就是非活动关系（虚线）。在度量值中用 USERELATIONSHIP 启用它：

blocks.text:
Sales by Ship Date =
CALCULATE (
    [Total Sales],
    USERELATIONSHIP ( Sales[ShipDate], 'Date'[Date] )
)

q.en: A Date table is related to Sales[OrderDate] (active) and Sales[DueDate] (inactive). Which DAX activates the second relationship in a measure?
q.zh: Date 表与 Sales[OrderDate]（活动）和 Sales[DueDate]（非活动）相关。哪个 DAX 能在度量值中启用第二个关系？

html.en: TREATAS on its own

why.en: TREATAS applies a virtual relationship, a different technique.
why.zh: TREATAS 套用虚拟关系，是另一种技巧。

html.en: RELATED

why.en: RELATED fetches a value over an existing active relationship.
why.zh: RELATED 是通过现有的活动关系取得值。

html.en: CROSSFILTER

why.en: CROSSFILTER changes direction, not which relationship is active.
why.zh: CROSSFILTER 改变方向，不改变哪个关系是活动的。

html.en: USERELATIONSHIP inside CALCULATE
html.zh: 在 CALCULATE 中使用 USERELATIONSHIP

why.en: Right: it activates the inactive relationship for that calculation only.
why.zh: 对：只在这个计算中启用该非活动关系。

q.en: What is the default cross-filter direction of a new one-to-many relationship?
q.zh: 新建立的一对多关系，默认的交叉筛选方向是什么？

html.en: Single, from the one side to the many side
None
Both

why.en: Both is the default for one-to-one relationships, not for one-to-many.
why.zh: 双向是一对一关系的默认值，不是一对多的。

html.en: From the many side to the one side

takeaways.en: A role-playing dimension is one dimension used for several roles, such as Order Date, Ship Date and Due Date.
takeaways.zh: 角色扮演维度是同一个维度表扮演多种角色，例如订单日期、发货日期和到期日期。

takeaways.en: Option 1: one table with one active and several inactive relationships, plus USERELATIONSHIP measures.
takeaways.zh: 方法一：一张表，一个活动关系加几个非活动关系，再配合 USERELATIONSHIP 度量值。

takeaways.en: Option 2: a copy of the dimension per role (reference query or calculated table), each with its own active relationship.
takeaways.zh: 方法二：为每个角色复制一份维度表（引用查询或计算表），各自有活动关系。

html.en: Sales has an OrderDate, a ShipDate and a DueDate. All three describe dates, so they all relate to the Date dimension — the dimension plays three roles.
html.zh: Sales 有 OrderDate、ShipDate 和 DueDate。三者都是日期，所以都关联到 Date 维度表——这个维度表扮演了三种角色。

rows.en: A measure per role (Sales by Ship Date…)
rows.zh: 每个角色一个度量值（按发货日期的销售……）

rows.en: Users pick 'Ship Date'[Year] directly; can show order and ship dates side by side
rows.zh: 用户直接选择 'Ship Date'[Year]；可以并排显示订单日期和发货日期

rows.en: Few measures need the other roles
rows.zh: 只有少数度量值需要其他角色

rows.en: Users slice by several roles freely
rows.zh: 用户要自由地按多种角色切片

blocks.text:
// Calculated table: a second date table for the Ship Date role
Ship Date = 'Date'

html.en: Rename copied columns (Ship Year, Ship Month) so report users can tell the roles apart.
html.zh: 把复制表的列改名（Ship Year、Ship Month），让报表用户能分辨不同角色。

q.en: Report users want a matrix with order year on rows and ship year on columns. Which design supports this?
q.zh: 报表用户想要一个矩阵，行是订单年份，列是发货年份。哪种设计能做到？

html.en: A bidirectional relationship
A many-to-many relationship
Separate Order Date and Ship Date tables, each with an active relationship
html.zh: 分开的 Order Date 和 Ship Date 表，各有活动关系

why.en: Right: both roles must filter at the same time, which needs two active paths.
why.zh: 对：两个角色必须同时筛选，所以需要两条活动路径。

html.en: One Date table with an inactive ShipDate relationship
html.zh: 一张 Date 表加一个非活动的 ShipDate 关系

why.en: Only one role can be on the axis from a single table.
why.zh: 一张表只能把一种角色放在轴上。

takeaways.en: Time intelligence needs a date table with one row per day, no gaps, covering whole years.
takeaways.zh: 时间智能需要一张日期表：每天一行、没有缺口、涵盖完整年份。

takeaways.en: Create it in Power Query, with DAX CALENDAR or CALENDARAUTO, or import it from the data warehouse — then Mark as date table.
takeaways.zh: 可在 Power Query 中建立、用 DAX 的 CALENDAR 或 CALENDARAUTO 建立，或从数据仓库导入——然后「标记为日期表」。

takeaways.en: Turn off Auto date/time for real models: it adds a hidden date table for every date column.
takeaways.zh: 正式的模型应关闭「自动日期/时间」：它会为每个日期列加一张隐藏的日期表。

html.en: Every model with dates needs one common date table that all fact tables share. It lets one Year slicer filter Sales, Budget and Inventory together, and it is required for DAX time intelligence functions to work reliably.
html.zh: 每个含日期的模型都需要一张所有事实表共用的通用日期表。它让一个年份切片器同时筛选 Sales、Budget 和 Inventory，也是 DAX 时间智能函数可靠运作的前提。

items.en: One row per date, no missing days, starting on 1 January (or the fiscal-year start) of the first year and ending on the last day of the last year.
items.zh: 每个日期一行、不缺日期，从第一年的 1 月 1 日（或财年开始日）到最后一年的最后一天。

items.en: A column of type Date with unique values — the key.
items.zh: 一个「日期」类型、值唯一的列——作为键。

items.en: Attribute columns: Year, Quarter, Month number, Month name, Week, Day of week, Fiscal year…
items.zh: 属性列：年、季度、月份编号、月份名称、周、星期、财年……

items.en: Mark as date table (Table tools) and choose the date column. Power BI then validates it and stops creating auto date tables for it.
items.zh: 标记为日期表（表工具），并选择日期列。Power BI 会验证它，并不再为其建立自动日期表。

blocks.text:
Date =
ADDCOLUMNS (
    CALENDAR ( DATE ( 2022, 1, 1 ), DATE ( 2026, 12, 31 ) ),
    "Year", YEAR ( [Date] ),
    "Month Number", MONTH ( [Date] ),
    "Month", FORMAT ( [Date], "MMM" ),
    "Quarter", "Q" & QUARTER ( [Date] )
)

rows.en: Every date between two dates you choose
rows.zh: 两个指定日期之间的每一天

rows.en: Whole years covering every date found in the model (optional fiscal year-end month)
rows.zh: 涵盖模型中所有日期的完整年份（可选财年结束月份）

html.en: Remember to set Sort by column: Month name sorted by Month number, otherwise months appear alphabetically (Apr, Aug, Dec…).
html.zh: 记得设定按列排序：月份名称按月份编号排序，否则月份会按字母顺序出现（Apr、Aug、Dec……）。

q.en: Your Date table was built from the distinct order dates in Sales, so it has gaps on days without orders. What goes wrong?
q.zh: 你的 Date 表是用 Sales 中不重复的订单日期建立的，所以没有订单的日子会有缺口。会出什么问题？

html.en: Nothing; gaps are fine
Slicers stop working
Relationships cannot be created
Time intelligence functions can return wrong or no results
html.zh: 时间智能函数可能返回错误结果或没有结果

why.en: Right: they need a complete, contiguous range of dates.
why.zh: 对：它们需要完整、连续的日期范围。

q.en: Months show in alphabetical order on a chart axis. How do you fix it?
q.zh: 图表轴上的月份按字母顺序显示。怎么修正？

html.en: Turn on Auto date/time
Sort the Month name column by the Month number column
html.zh: 把月份名称列设为按月份编号列排序

why.en: Right: Sort by column in Column tools.
why.zh: 对：在「列工具」中使用「按列排序」。

html.en: Sort the visual descending
html.zh: 把视觉对象设为降序排序

html.en: Change Month to a Date type

takeaways.en: Hide keys and technical columns; show users only what they should drag into visuals.
takeaways.zh: 隐藏键和技术性的列；只让用户看到应该拖进视觉对象的内容。

takeaways.en: Set data categories (City, Country, Latitude, URL, Image URL) so maps and links work.
takeaways.zh: 设定数据类别（城市、国家/地区、纬度、网址、图像网址），让地图和链接正常运作。

takeaways.en: Set Summarize by to Don't summarize for numbers that must not be added up, such as Year or IDs.
takeaways.zh: 对不应相加的数字（如年份或 ID）把「汇总依据」设为「不汇总」。

html.en: A good model is easy to use. The Properties pane in Model view and Column tools in Table view control how each table and column behaves in reports.
html.zh: 好的模型要容易使用。模型视图的属性窗格和表视图的列工具决定每张表和每个列在报表中的表现。

rows.en: Friendly names ("Sales Amount" not "SLS_AMT"); descriptions show as tooltips in the Data pane
rows.zh: 友好名称（「销售金额」而不是「SLS_AMT」）；说明会在「数据」窗格中显示为工具提示

rows.en: Hide keys, sort columns and helper columns
rows.zh: 隐藏键、排序用的列和辅助列

rows.en: Currency, percentage, thousands separator, date format
rows.zh: 货币、百分比、千位分隔符、日期格式

rows.en: Address, City, Country/Region, Postal code, Latitude, Longitude, Web URL, Image URL, Barcode
rows.zh: 地址、城市、国家/地区、邮政编码、纬度、经度、Web URL、图像 URL、条形码

rows.en: Sum, Average, Count… or Don't summarize
rows.zh: 求和、平均值、计数……或不汇总

rows.en: Month name by month number, size "S, M, L" by a size order
rows.zh: 月份名称按月份编号；尺寸「S、M、L」按尺寸顺序
把大量度量值分组到文件夹
年 → 季度 → 月，用于向下钻取

rows.en: Help Q&A and Copilot understand "revenue" means Sales Amount
rows.zh: 帮助问答和 Copilot 理解「revenue」就是销售金额

html.en: A common trap: a Year column is summed ("2,024,000") in a visual. The fix is Summarize by → Don't summarize (or make the column Text).
html.zh: 常见陷阱：年份列在视觉对象中被加总成「2,024,000」。解决办法是「汇总依据 → 不汇总」（或把列改为文本）。

q.en: A column holds website addresses and must appear as clickable links in a table visual. What do you set?
q.zh: 某列存放网址，必须在表格视觉对象中显示为可点击的链接。要设定什么？

html.en: A hierarchy
Data category: Web URL

why.en: Right; then turn on URL icon in the table's formatting if you want an icon.
why.zh: 对；若想显示图标，再在表格格式中开启 URL 图标。

html.en: Summarize by: Don't summarize
Data type: Text

why.en: It already is text; the category makes it a link.
why.zh: 它本来就是文本；类别才会让它变成链接。

heading.en: When to use calculated columns and tables
heading.zh: 何时使用计算列和计算表

takeaways.en: A calculated column is computed row by row at refresh and stored; use it when you need to slice, filter or group by the result.
takeaways.zh: 计算列在刷新时逐行计算并存储；当你需要按结果切片、筛选或分组时使用。

takeaways.en: A measure is computed at query time for the current filters; use it for anything you aggregate.
takeaways.zh: 度量值在查询时按当前筛选条件计算；凡是要汇总的都用度量值。

takeaways.en: Calculated tables suit date tables, role-playing copies and small helper tables built from the model.
takeaways.zh: 计算表适用于日期表、角色扮演副本，以及由模型生成的小型辅助表。

rows.en: At query time, per cell of a visual
rows.zh: 查询时，针对视觉对象的每个单元格
行上下文（能看到当前行）
筛选上下文（能看到当前筛选）

rows.en: Slicers, axes, filters, grouping: Age Band, Full Name, Is Weekend
rows.zh: 切片器、轴、筛选、分组：年龄段、全名、是否周末

rows.en: Numbers to aggregate: Total Sales, Margin %, YoY
rows.zh: 要汇总的数字：总销售额、利润率、同比

html.en: If a column can be created in Power Query instead, prefer Power Query: it compresses better and keeps logic in one place. Use DAX calculated columns when the formula needs other model tables (RELATED) or DAX-only functions.
html.zh: 如果某列也能在 Power Query 中建立，优先用 Power Query：压缩效果更好，逻辑也集中在一处。当公式需要其他模型表（RELATED）或只有 DAX 才有的函数时，再用 DAX 计算列。

q.en: Users want to slice sales by price band (Budget, Standard, Premium). Should Price Band be a measure or a column?
q.zh: 用户想按价格段（低价、标准、高价）切片销售数据。价格段该是度量值还是列？

html.en: A visual-level filter
A measure

why.en: Measures cannot be placed in a slicer or on an axis.
why.zh: 度量值不能放进切片器，也不能放在轴上。

html.en: A column (Power Query or calculated column)

why.en: Right: slicers and axes need stored column values.
why.zh: 对：切片器和轴需要存储的列值。

html.en: A calculated table
